name: TX-11
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Pfluger running with large financial advantage ($2.9M vs $47K cash)
No polling and no expert ratings; markets price Democrats at ~3%
model.rationale: Pfluger is a well-funded incumbent in a district that leans Republican by 17 points, and Reynolds has raised only about $89K with minimal cash on hand. Prediction markets give Democrats roughly a 3% chance, consistent with the fundamentals-based margin near -17.
model.watch: A major polling surprise or a late influx of outside spending against Pfluger would be the only realistic path to moving this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
West Texas's 11th District is solidly Republican territory, with a partisan lean of about 17 points toward the GOP. August Pfluger returns as the incumbent after easily securing renomination, and he holds a decisive financial edge: roughly $3.2 million raised and $2.9 million on hand, with outside groups supporting him and none opposing.

Democratic challenger Claire Reynolds has raised under $100,000 and has only about $47,000 in the bank, with no outside spending on either side. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets put Democratic chances near 3%. The forecast is a Safe Republican hold, with Pfluger expected to win by a wide margin.
